title: Willie Warner, Hippolyte Charles and Vic
summary: Vincent describes Willie Warner as a printer who played at night and worked with big George Williams and Eddie Hickman. He recalls playing with Hippolyte Charles's band and Oak's brother Vic, who had a weak heart.

story.theme_name: Illness, injury and the deaths of colleagues
story.community_name: Illness, injury and death among jazz musicians

blocks.x: Willie Warner? I said you never know him, eh? You know where you talk about Willie Warner?
Yeah, I heard talk about him.

Oh, yeah. He used to play with people. And then he played with us. And then he played with George Williams, big George Williams. Then he had a band, you know. Boy, he played with Peerrell until Peerrell died. Then after that, he didn't spend with anybody, you know. Work all the time. He was a printer, you know. Played music at night. He was a heavy drinker. He was the finest man in one of me. He didn't look at him up there. I used to play with him sometimes too. Me and him and Eddie Hickman. Three piece. He could play too.
